covers: The Motorola 6821 peripheral interface adapter as a chip

entries.name: Motorola 6821 PIA
entries.description: Two 8-bit parallel ports, each with two handshake lines and an interrupt output, behind four registers.
entries.behaviour: Address bits 0 and 1 pick one of four offsets, and bit 2 of a control register chooses data or direction register at offsets 0 and 2. read_alt and write_alt swap the two address bits. IRQA and IRQB follow flags set by CA1, CA2, CB1 and CB2 edges and cleared by reading the port.

handlers.read_alt: register read with address bits 0 and 1 swapped
handlers.write_alt: register write with address bits 0 and 1 swapped
handlers.porta_w: drives all eight port A input pins
handlers.portb_w: drives all eight port B input pins
handlers.ca1_w: drives the CA1 input line; an active edge sets the CA1 flag
handlers.ca2_w: drives the CA2 input line; an active edge sets the CA2 flag only while CA2 is an input
handlers.cb1_w: drives the CB1 input line; an active edge sets the CB1 flag
handlers.cb2_w: drives the CB2 input line; an active edge sets the CB2 flag only while CB2 is an input
handlers.a_output: port A output value as seen on the pins
handlers.b_output: port B output value, output bits only unless a tri-state handler fills the rest
handlers.ca2_output_z: CA2 level, high while CA2 is an input (internal pullup)
handlers.cb2_output_z: true while CB2 is an input (high impedance)
handlers.port_b_z_mask: mask of port B bits that are inputs (high impedance)
